_readme: S739 wave B, the gap census's Next wave (census of 2026-11-26 06:54Z, run 45771011713; levers reader_page_assignment and paid_read): 2 certificates of Sierra College whose sections print on the Business department page past the text the capture sends (college-page-read run 45782471633, the page as the capture reads it: 51,984 characters, its Degrees/Certificates tab panel 23,738). Filed as named gaps and never sent to a paid read. Each filed record stays as filed (the load skips a record that places none of its listed courses). No model call, no Supabase write. Each is the college's to settle in COCI or its catalog.

reasons.text_window_cut: The program's own section prints on its department page past the 16,000 characters of the page's text the capture sends (text_window), so the extraction is given the page's other sections and none of this one's list; a forced re-read would send the same cut text.
